commit.message:
tools: detect transaction origin access in callbacks

Add the txscope analysis plugin to prevent ExecTx callbacks from
accessing the executor that opened their transaction. Detect direct
uses, alias chains, conversions, helper arguments, and nested
transactions while permitting calls through a distinct database.

Require inline callbacks so the check cannot be bypassed through a named
function, and enable the analyzer in the repository lint configuration.

commit.message:
invoices: use tx query for settled AMP invoices

Fetch settled AMP sub-invoices through the query object supplied to the
transaction callback. Using the store's pool here can wait for a second
connection while the transaction retains the first one, deadlocking a
constrained pool.

Add a single-connection SQLite regression test so any pool access from
this transaction fails instead of going unnoticed.

commit.message: build: use local TLV decoder in lnd builds
tlv: test valid record compatibility and document bounds

tlv: avoid eager allocations for declared record lengths

In this commit, we update the TLV decoders to grow variable-length buffers as data is read instead of reserving the full encoded length up front. We also reject lengths that can't be represented by io.CopyN before calling it.

We preserve the existing EOF behavior for truncated values and extend the stream fuzzer to cover non-P2P decoding. Dedicated seeds cover unknown records and known variable-byte records.

commit.message:
multi: count forwarding packages efficiently

Add a count-only forwarding package store method that iterates
package height buckets without materializing their HTLC contents.

Use the new method for waiting-close and pending-force-close channels
so PendingChannels keeps populating the existing response field
without a new request flag.

Make SQL ForAll preserve empty leaf values and propagate row iteration
errors, with regression coverage for both cases.

Add forwarding package correctness coverage and a PostgreSQL benchmark
for the count-only path.
